description: Values of the artifact_type column in the tools file: the main thing a learner can keep from a tool. Blank when produces_artifact is false or not known.

types.meaning: A written document the Hub stores for the learner, opened again from the Command Center and My work.
A certificate the learner issues, recorded as a certificate or offered as a PEM download.
A key the learner generates, recorded as a key.
A TLS handshake simulation kept in the learner's history.
A run record of the tool (JSON or Markdown) the learner downloads and can store with Save to my evidence.
Any other file the learner downloads (CSV, JSON, PEM, signature, bundle, log, zip), or one complete generated record copied out.
